identificationModule.briefTitle: Assessment of the Efficacy and Safety of Olaparib Monotherapy Versus Physicians Choice Chemotherapy in the Treatment of Metastatic Breast Cancer Patients With Germline BRCA1/2 Mutations.
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Open Label, Randomised, Controlled, Multi-centre Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of Olaparib Monotherapy Versus Physicians Choice Chemotherapy in the Treatment of Metastatic Breast Cancer Patients With Germline BRCA1/2 Mutations.

armGroups.label: Physician's choice chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Capecitabine 2500 mg/m2 d1-14 q 21, or Vinorelbine 30 mg/m2 d1,8 q 21, or Eribulin 1.4 mg/m2 d1,8 q 21

interventions.name: Olaparib
interventions.description: Patients will be administered olaparib orally twice daily (bid) at 300 mg. Two (2) x 150 mg olaparib tablets should be taken at the same times each morning and evening of each day, approximately 12 hours apart with approximately 240 mL of water.

interventions.name: Physician's choice chemotherapy
interventions.description:
Investigators will declare one of the following regimens:

* Capecitabine 2500 mg/m2 po daily (divided in 2 doses) x 14 days, repeat every 21 days
* Vinorelbine 30 mg/m2 IV Day 1 and Day 8, repeat every 21 days
* Eribulin 1.4 mg/m2 IV Day 1 and Day 8, repeat every 21 days
